description: The Cook Islands Coastal Calculator uses Excel worksheets to estimate wave transformation, run-up and overtopping for fringing-reef settings. SPREP documents application to Oneroa, scenario controls and important limits, including no inland inundation calculation. The metadata is published or maintained by NIWA / SPREP PACC. Coverage is at national scale in Cook Islands. Any further spatial resolution, complete time span or sampling interval beyond the details above is not verified here. The provider page supplies a documented method or software entry point; package availability and execution requirements were not independently tested. Licence: not stated in the inspected metadata. The report is public; availability, licence and cost of the calculator workbook were not established. Caveats: The documented version requires Excel 2010 and treats homogeneous fringing-reef profiles. It estimates shoreline run-up but does not simulate inland inundation. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support network flow. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims. Related catalogue context is model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not a verified software dependency or claim of compatible inputs.
